title: Biography Flash: Buffett Bets Big on Alphabet and Cuts Off Gates Foundation
summary: Warren Buffett has had a surprisingly high drama week for a 95 year old who still insists he is just a guy who likes numbers and hamburgers. In the same CNBC interview, as covered by The Times of India and Asiae, Buffett revealed that the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation has been cut off from further donations after more than two decades and tens of billions of dollars of giving.
